name: Orrery
notes: A new look: an oxblood night sky, brass orbit rings with an engraved dial, gold star shards and a solar Fever.
Updates: Graze now checks for new versions and waits for you to tap Update, so a run is never interrupted.
What’s new: you see this list once after each update.
Install it: on the web, Graze can be added to your home screen and played offline.
Backup files now save directly when you play on the web.

name: Sync
notes: Cloud save inside Claude, encrypted link codes, direct transfer codes and backup files. Everything merges; nothing is overwritten.
Boons after each bonus rush, recall revives, recall chains and reverse gates.
Nine new packs, including Organic Chemistry, Latin, German, Polish, Logic and Philosophy & Theology.
Eight more Codex pages and a Workshop of permanent upgrades.

name: Recall
notes: Recall gates with a spaced-review schedule.
Codex reading pages with comprehension questions.
A daily ritual, a cue you choose, and the Forge for your own material.

name: Fever
notes: Fever mode, power-ups, bonus rushes, hoppers and a soundtrack that builds with your multiplier.

name: First light
notes: One tap, two orbits, grazes, missions and trails.
